component.name: LIOS
component.summary: Send the clipboard, a file, or text to a paired phone

description.p: LIOS bridges the clipboard between a Linux desktop and a paired phone. Press a keyboard shortcut to send whatever is on the clipboard -- text, an image, or a file copied in the file manager -- and it arrives on the phone within seconds. Sending the other way raises a notification whose default action puts the item straight on the clipboard.
Runs quietly in the background with no window open, and keeps a short local history of recent items.
